title: 🔥 THE THIEF COMES TO STEAL, KILL, AND DESTROY – WHO IS HE REALLY?
paragraphs:
🔥 THE THIEF COMES TO STEAL, KILL, AND DESTROY – WHO IS HE REALLY?
💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, I often hear John 10:10 quoted, but I’ve heard different interpretations. Some say the thief is Satan, while others say it refers to false teachers. Who is the thief Jesus warned about?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people misinterpret John 10:10, using it to promote false prosperity teachings or to misidentify the enemy. But the Bible makes it clear: Jesus wasn’t just talking about the devil—He was exposing the true dangers that threaten our spiritual lives!

📖 John 10:10 (KJV)
"The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly."
🚨 THE TRUTH: THE THIEF IS ANYTHING OR ANYONE WHO LEADS YOU AWAY FROM GOD!

✔️ What does ‘steal, kill, and destroy’ really mean?
✔️ Is Jesus talking about Satan, false teachers, or something else?
✔️ What does it mean to have ‘life more abundantly’ in Christ?
🔥 LET’S BREAK THIS DOWN WITH SCRIPTURE, WISDOM, AND TRUTH!
WHO IS THE THIEF THAT STEALS, KILLS, AND DESTROYS?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, many say the thief in John 10:10 is Satan, but others claim it refers to false teachers. Who was Jesus really talking about?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! While many assume the thief refers only to Satan, a closer look at the context of John 10 shows that Jesus was exposing false teachers, religious leaders, and anyone who leads people away from God’s truth!

📖 John 10:8 (KJV)
"All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them."
🚨 THE THIEF REPRESENTS:

✔️ False teachers who twist God’s Word for their own gain.
✔️ Religious leaders who burden people with man-made traditions instead of God’s truth.
✔️ Satan, who ultimately works through deception to steal people’s salvation.
🔥 EXAMPLE: THE PHARISEES – SPIRITUAL THIEVES WHO STOLE GOD’S TRUTH!

📖 Matthew 23:13 (KJV)
"But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in."

✔️ They stole the truth of God’s Word by replacing it with their own traditions.
✔️ They spiritually killed people by keeping them in religious bondage.
✔️ They destroyed lives by rejecting Jesus, the only way to salvation!
🚨 THE THIEF IS ANYONE OR ANYTHING THAT LEADS YOU AWAY FROM JESUS!
ORIGINAL GREEK & HEBREW TEXT STUDY – CLARIFYING THE TRUE MEANING OF JOHN 10:10!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, people often misinterpret John 10:10, but what does the original Greek text reveal?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! To understand John 10:10 correctly, we must examine the original Greek words to clarify Jesus’ true meaning.

📖 John 10:10 (KJV - with Greek terms explained):
"The thief (κλέπτης – kleptēs) cometh not, but for to steal (κλέπτω – kleptō), and to kill (θύω – thyō), and to destroy (ἀπόλλυμι – apollymi): I am come that they might have life (ζωή – zōē), and that they might have it more abundantly (περισσός – perissos)."
🚨 THE TRUTH FROM THE GREEK TEXT:

✔️ Thief (κλέπτης – kleptēs) – This word doesn’t only refer to Satan but also to deceivers, false teachers, and religious manipulators who exploit God’s people.
✔️ Steal (κλέπτω – kleptō) – This refers to secretly taking away something valuable (in this case, the truth of God’s Word).
✔️ Kill (θύω – thyō) – This means to sacrifice or slaughter—false teachers often lead people to spiritual death.
✔️ Destroy (ἀπόλλυμι – apollymi) – This word means utter destruction or perishing, similar to what happens to those who follow false gospels (Galatians 1:6-9).
✔️ Life (ζωή – zōē) – This doesn’t mean just physical life but eternal, divine life that comes only through Christ.
✔️ More abundantly (περισσός – perissos) – This means overflowing, beyond measure—but in a spiritual sense, not material riches!
🔥 THE PROSPERITY GOSPEL USES THIS VERSE TO PROMOTE WEALTH, BUT THE ORIGINAL TEXT REFERS TO SPIRITUAL LIFE IN CHRIST!

📖 1 John 5:12 (KJV)
"He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life."
🚀 THE TRUE ABUNDANT LIFE IS FOUND IN KNOWING JESUS—NOT IN WORLDLY SUCCESS!
OLD TESTAMENT PROPHECY CONNECTION – HOW JOHN 10:10 FULFILLS THE SCRIPTURES!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, is John 10:10 connected to Old Testament prophecy? Did Jesus fulfill any Scriptures with this statement?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Jesus wasn’t just giving a random teaching—He was fulfilling specific Old Testament prophecies about false shepherds vs. the Good Shepherd!

📖 Ezekiel 34:2-4 (KJV) – PROPHECY OF FALSE SHEPHERDS
"Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel... Ye eat the fat, and ye clothe you with the wool, ye kill them that are fed: but ye feed not the flock."

✔️ Ezekiel prophesied about false shepherds who steal, kill, and destroy God’s flock.
✔️ Jesus fulfilled this prophecy by exposing the Pharisees as spiritual thieves (John 10:8).
✔️ God Himself promised to send the TRUE SHEPHERD to rescue His sheep!

📖 Ezekiel 34:23 (KJV) – PROPHECY OF THE GOOD SHEPHERD
"And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd."
🔥 JESUS IS THE FULFILLMENT OF THIS PROPHECY! HE IS THE GOOD SHEPHERD WHO GIVES ABUNDANT LIFE!

📖 John 10:11 (KJV)
"I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep."
🚀 THIS CONNECTION PROVES THAT JESUS WAS NOT TEACHING ABOUT EARTHLY WEALTH, BUT ETERNAL LIFE AS THE TRUE SHEPHERD!
WHAT DOES ‘STEAL, KILL, AND DESTROY’ REALLY MEAN?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, when Jesus said the thief comes to steal, kill, and destroy, what did He mean?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Jesus was warning about how false teaching and deception lead to spiritual destruction. Let’s break it down biblically.

📖 Hosea 4:6 (KJV)
"My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge."
🚨 HOW THE THIEF OPERATES:

✔️ STEALS – False teachers steal the truth of God’s Word from people.
✔️ KILLS – Spiritual deception leads to spiritual death.
✔️ DESTROYS – Those who follow lies are ultimately destroyed in judgment.
🔥 EXAMPLE: SATAN IN THE GARDEN OF EDEN

📖 Genesis 3:4-5 (KJV)
"And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die... ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil."

✔️ Satan STOLE the truth by twisting God’s Word.
✔️ His lie LED TO SPIRITUAL DEATH for Adam and Eve.
✔️ His deception BROUGHT DESTRUCTION upon all humanity.
🚨 THE THIEF’S GREATEST WEAPON IS DECEPTION—BECAUSE DECEPTION LEADS TO DESTRUCTION!
WHAT DOES IT MEAN TO HAVE LIFE ‘MORE ABUNDANTLY’?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, some use John 10:10 to preach the prosperity gospel, saying Jesus promised wealth and luxury. Is that what ‘life more abundantly’ means?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! The prosperity gospel falsely teaches that "abundant life" means financial riches, but Jesus NEVER promised material wealth—He promised spiritual abundance!

📖 Luke 12:15 (KJV)
"A man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth."
🚨 TRUE ABUNDANT LIFE IS NOT ABOUT MONEY—IT’S ABOUT ETERNAL LIFE!

✔️ It’s the abundance of PEACE, not possessions.
✔️ It’s the abundance of JOY, not jewelry.
✔️ It’s the abundance of SALVATION, not status.
🔥 EXAMPLE: THE RICH MAN AND LAZARUS

📖 Luke 16:19-23 (KJV)
"There was a certain rich man... and there was a certain beggar named Lazarus..."

✔️ The rich man had an abundance of wealth, but no eternal life!
✔️ Lazarus had nothing on earth, but inherited the Kingdom of God!
✔️ Jesus is teaching that true life is found in HIM—not in material success!
FINAL CHALLENGE – WILL YOU FOLLOW JESUS, THE GOOD SHEPHERD, OR BE DECEIVED BY THE THIEF?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, if there are so many spiritual thieves out there, how can I make sure I’m truly following Jesus and not being deceived?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Jesus gave us a clear way to recognize His voice and follow Him, instead of being led astray by thieves and false teachers.

📖 John 10:27 (KJV)
"My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me."
🚨 THE TRUTH: ONLY THOSE WHO TRULY KNOW JESUS WILL RECOGNIZE HIS VOICE AND FOLLOW HIM!

✔️ The sheep (true believers) listen to Jesus—the Good Shepherd.
✔️ The thief (false teachers and the devil) tries to lead them astray.
✔️ Only those who are filled with the Holy Spirit can discern truth from deception!
🔥 EXAMPLE: THE FALSE SHEPHERDS WHO LED ISRAEL ASTRAY

📖 Ezekiel 34:2-4 (KJV)
"Woe be to the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the flocks?... Ye eat the fat, and ye clothe you with the wool, ye kill them that are fed: but ye feed not the flock."

✔️ False shepherds use people for their own gain instead of leading them to God.
✔️ They steal the truth of God’s Word and replace it with lies.
✔️ Jesus came as the TRUE SHEPHERD to bring life to His flock!
🔥 HOW TO MAKE SURE YOU ARE FOLLOWING JESUS AND NOT A THIEF:

✔️ TEST EVERYTHING BY SCRIPTURE! – Don’t believe something just because a preacher says it—compare it with the Bible!
✔️ PRAY FOR DISCERNMENT! – Ask the Holy Spirit to reveal truth and expose deception.
✔️ STAY CLOSE TO THE GOOD SHEPHERD! – Read God’s Word daily and build your personal relationship with Jesus.

📖 Matthew 7:15 (KJV)
"Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves."
🚨 SIGNS YOU ARE FOLLOWING THE GOOD SHEPHERD:

✔️ You love the truth of God’s Word, not man-made teachings.
✔️ You test every teaching against Scripture (1 Thessalonians 5:21).
✔️ You reject false gospels that promise wealth instead of salvation.
✔️ You stay close to Jesus through prayer and obedience.
🔥 SIGNS YOU ARE BEING DECEIVED BY THE THIEF:

❌ You follow pastors who promote material wealth over spiritual growth.
❌ You believe in religious traditions more than biblical truth.
❌ You listen to teachings that make you comfortable in sin.
❌ You do not compare teachings with what the Bible actually says.

📖 Matthew 7:15 (KJV)
"Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves."
📢 TAG 3 FRIENDS who need to hear this message!
📢 TAG 3 FRIENDS who need to hear this message!
PRAYER OF COMMITMENT – CHOOSING JESUS OVER SPIRITUAL DECEPTION!
🙏 PRAY THIS WITH ME:

"Heavenly Father, I choose to follow Jesus, my Good Shepherd. Open my eyes to see the truth and give me wisdom to recognize deception. I surrender my heart to You alone and reject every false teaching that leads away from Christ. Keep me close to Your voice and protect me from the thief who comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I trust You for true life, not worldly riches. Fill me with the Holy Spirit and lead me in righteousness. In Jesus' mighty name, Amen!"

📖 Psalm 23:1 (KJV)
"The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want."
PROOF, SOURCES & BIBLICAL EVIDENCE – BACKING UP EVERY CLAIM WITH FACTS!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, I see that John 10:10 is often misused. How can I prove biblically that Jesus was talking about false teachers and not just Satan?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! The Bible commands us to "prove all things" (1 Thessalonians 5:21) and warns that many will twist Scripture for their own gain. Here’s the biblical proof, historical evidence, and theological sources that confirm the correct interpretation of John 10:10!

📖 2 Timothy 4:3-4 (KJV)
"For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears; And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables."
🚨 THE TRUTH: JESUS WARNED ABOUT FALSE TEACHERS WHO LEAD SHEEP ASTRAY!

🔎 SCRIPTURAL REFERENCES & CONTEXT CHECKS
✔️ John 10:1 – "He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber." (Jesus identifies false teachers as thieves.)
✔️ John 10:8 – "All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them." (The thief represents those who mislead God's people.)
✔️ Matthew 7:13-15 – "Wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction… Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep’s clothing." (False teachers lead people to destruction.)
✔️ 2 Corinthians 11:13-15 – "For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ… Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light." (False teachers work under Satan’s deception.)
✔️ Jeremiah 23:1-2 – "Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the Lord." (God condemns religious leaders who lead people astray.)

📜 HISTORICAL & THEOLOGICAL SOURCES
🔗 Early Church Fathers on False Teachers as Thieves:
✔️ John Chrysostom (347–407 AD): Taught that John 10:10 primarily refers to corrupt religious leaders who misuse their authority.
✔️ Augustine of Hippo (354–430 AD): Explained that Jesus was warning about religious deception, not just the devil.
✔️ Matthew Henry’s Commentary: Confirms that John 10:10 is about false teachers, not material prosperity.

🔗 Reliable Commentaries & Biblical Studies:
✔️ Barnes’ Notes on the Bible – Teaches that the "thief" includes all who hinder salvation through deception.
✔️ Strong’s Concordance – Confirms that the Greek word for "thief" (kleptēs) means someone who misleads and exploits others.
